# Go API

The Go packages under [`ext/contracts`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts): each [contract](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts)'s interface, the types its operations take and return, and the helpers it ships, for a custom build or an extension that calls one. Generated from the source with `go/doc`, examples included. An extension's JavaScript side is in the [JavaScript API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/javascript).

## Contracts

| Package | |
|---|---|
| [`api-tokens/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/api-tokens/v1) | Package apitokensv1 is the api-tokens/v1 contract: an app's API tokens. |
| [`api-tokens/verify/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/api-tokens/verify/v1) | Package verifyv1 is the api-tokens.verify/v1 contract: another server checks an app's API token. |
| [`bulkmail/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/bulkmail/v1) | Package bulkmailv1 is the bulkmail/v1 contract: campaigns to many recipients, sent at a safe pace. |
| [`cache/clear/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/cache/clear/v1) | Package clearv1 is the cache.clear/v1 contract: empty an app's cache buckets from outside the app's code, so its admins (the dashboard, `pocketone remote cache clear`, an agent) can drop what cache/v1 keeps for it after a change that left stale entries behind. |
| [`cache/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/cache/v1) | Package cachev1 is the cache/v1 contract: named buckets of bytes an app keeps for a while, so extensions and apps can remember what was expensive to compute. |
| [`cli/commands/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/cli/commands/v1) | Package clicmdv1 is the cli.commands/v1 contract: the `pocketone` command tree. |
| [`deploy/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/deploy/v1) | Package deployv1 is the deploy/v1 contract: a project's code files on an app (check, upload, commit, list, read, write, delete, tree). |
| [`gate/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/gate/v1) | Package gatev1 is the gate/v1 contract: what admits requests on a multisite host, before an instance is served or forwarded (a firewall: peer allow lists, client IPs, rate limits). |
| [`http/wrap/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/http/wrap/v1) | Package wrapv1 is the http.wrap/v1 contract: middleware around everything a multisite host serves (a Server-Timing header, request logging). |
| [`instance/fs/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/fs/v1) | Package fsv1 is the instance.fs/v1 contract: one instance's code files on local disk, for extensions that read and write them (ext/deploy today). |
| [`instance/lookup/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/lookup/v1) | Package lookupv1 is the instance.lookup/v1 contract: a multisite host asks for a hostname it doesn't know. |
| [`instance/resolve/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/resolve/v1) | Package resolvev1 is the instance.resolve/v1 contract: on a control plane (a mothership), what a hostname serves for a given edge, built from the control plane's own records, and which records each answer was built from. |
| [`instance/source/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/source/v1) | Package sourcev1 is the instance.source/v1 contract: the instance record a multisite host serves (its id, hostnames, version, folder, secrets, limits, ...) and where the records come from. |
| [`instance/source/v1/sourcetest`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/source/v1/sourcetest) | Package sourcetest is an instance.source/v1 provider for tests: a fixed list of instances that a test can change while it runs, the way an edit to a host's instances file or a control plane's update would. |
| [`instance/status/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/status/v1) | Package statusv1 is the instance.status/v1 contract: what a multisite host knows about each instance it runs (starting, running, idle, failed), as it changes. |
| [`instance/tokens/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/tokens/v1) | Package tokensv1 is the instance.tokens/v1 contract: a multisite host checks an API token one of its instances issued, so it can accept the instance's own tokens on the routes it answers for that instance (deploy/v1, remote/v1). |
| [`instance/watch/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/instance/watch/v1) | Package watchv1 is the instance.watch/v1 contract: an edge follows a control plane (a mothership) lazily. |
| [`kv/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/kv/v1) | Package kvv1 is the kv/v1 contract: an app's key-value store. |
| [`llm`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm) | Package llm holds what the llm.* contracts share: a model reference, generated files, usage, model info, jobs and errors. |
| [`llm/align/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/align/v1) | Package alignv1 is the llm.align/v1 contract: forced alignment. |
| [`llm/chat/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/chat/v1) | Package chatv1 is the llm.chat/v1 contract: stored conversations with the app's language model. |
| [`llm/embed/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/embed/v1) | Package embedv1 is the llm.embed/v1 contract: a model turns texts into vectors, for search by meaning. |
| [`llm/image/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/image/v1) | Package imagev1 is the llm.image/v1 contract: a model makes pictures from a prompt, and from reference pictures. |
| [`llm/ledger/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/ledger/v1) | Package ledgerv1 is the llm.ledger/v1 contract: what an app's model calls have used and cost, read from the ledger every llm.* call leaves (the provider's own record of each call), and how much of each limit is left. |
| [`llm/music/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/music/v1) | Package musicv1 is the llm.music/v1 contract: a model makes music from a prompt (and lyrics). |
| [`llm/search/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/search/v1) | Package searchv1 is the llm.search/v1 contract: named buckets of content an app searches. |
| [`llm/speech/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/speech/v1) | Package speechv1 is the llm.speech/v1 contract: a model reads text aloud. |
| [`llm/text/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/text/v1) | Package textv1 is the llm.text/v1 contract: a language model answers a prompt or a conversation. |
| [`llm/transcribe/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/transcribe/v1) | Package transcribev1 is the llm.transcribe/v1 contract: a model writes down what's said in audio. |
| [`llm/video/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/llm/video/v1) | Package videov1 is the llm.video/v1 contract: a model makes a video from a prompt (and a first frame). |
| [`mail/fallback/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/mail/fallback/v1) | Package fallbackv1 is the mail.fallback/v1 contract: where an app's mail goes when its SMTP is off. |
| [`mail/feedback/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/mail/feedback/v1) | Package feedbackv1 is the mail.feedback/v1 contract: what mail providers report back about mail an app sent (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), received at one place and turned into [Event]s that any extension can act on. |
| [`mail/suppression/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/mail/suppression/v1) | Package suppressionv1 is the mail.suppression/v1 contract: addresses an app must not send bulk mail to (unsubscribed, bounced, complained), and the unsubscribe link every bulk message carries. |
| [`mcp/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/mcp/v1) | Package mcpv1 is the mcp/v1 contract: the app's Model Context Protocol endpoint, so agents (a Claude connector, Claude Code, any Streamable HTTP client) can work with it. |
| [`oauth/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/oauth/v1) | Package oauthv1 is the oauth/v1 contract: an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for the app (authorization code with PKCE, device code, refresh, revocation, dynamic and metadata-document client registration), so the CLI and MCP clients like Claude can sign in. |
| [`remote/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/remote/v1) | Package remotev1 is the remote/v1 contract: remote control of an app. |
| [`remote/v1/remoteclient`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/remote/v1/remoteclient) | Package remoteclient is remote/v1's CLI client: the remotes a project links (.pocketone/remotes.yaml), saved logins, sign-in (an API token, a password, or OAuth in the browser or with a device code), and an authenticated HTTP client for a remote. |
| [`restore/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/restore/v1) | Package restorev1 is the restore/v1 contract: put an app's data back as it was at a moment. |
| [`runtime/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/runtime/v1) | Package runtimev1 is the runtime/v1 contract: what runs a multisite host's instances (ext/pocker as isolates, ext/docker in containers). |
| [`settings/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/settings/v1) | Package settingsv1 is the settings/v1 contract: the settings an app's admins change for its extensions (pitr's S3 bucket, bulkmail's sending limits), one API for all of them. |
| [`templates/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/templates/v1) | Package templatesv1 is the templates/v1 contract: an extension's own pages as a set of Go html/template files that a project can override. |
| [`tls/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/tls/v1) | Package tlsv1 is the tls/v1 contract: the TLS of a multisite host's main listener (automatic certificates). |
| [`vacuum/v1`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/vacuum/v1) | Package vacuumv1 is the vacuum/v1 contract: an app's databases are compacted (SQLite VACUUM) so space freed by deleted records goes back to the disk, and its admins can see when that last happened. |

## PocketBase

PocketOne's core: the app (`core`), its HTTP API (`apis`), the tools it's built from, and the test helpers (`tests`). A custom build or an extension imports these by the module path in each page's import line.

| Package | |
|---|---|
| [`pocketbase`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase) |  |
| [`apis`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/apis) |  |
| [`core`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/core) | Package core is the backbone of PocketBase. |
| [`core/validators`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/core/validators) | Package validators implements some common custom PocketBase validators. |
| [`forms`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/forms) |  |
| [`mails`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/mails) | Package mails implements various helper methods for sending common emails like forgotten password, verification, etc. |
| [`plugins/ghupdate`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/plugins/ghupdate) | Package ghupdate implements a new command to selfupdate the current PocketBase executable with the latest GitHub release. |
| [`plugins/migratecmd`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/plugins/migratecmd) | Package migratecmd adds a new "migrate" command support to a PocketBase instance. |
| [`plugins/update`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/plugins/update) | Package update implements a new command to replace the current PocketBase executable with the one from the latest BugStage releases. |
| [`tests`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tests) | Package tests provides common helpers and mocks used in PocketBase application tests. |
| [`tools/archive`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/archive) |  |
| [`tools/auth`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/auth) |  |
| [`tools/cron`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/cron) | Package cron implements a crontab-like service to execute and schedule repeative tasks/jobs. |
| [`tools/dbutils`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/dbutils) |  |
| [`tools/filesystem`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/filesystem) |  |
| [`tools/filesystem/blob`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/filesystem/blob) | Package blob defines a lightweight abstration for interacting with various storage services (local filesystem, S3, etc.). |
| [`tools/hook`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/hook) |  |
| [`tools/inflector`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/inflector) |  |
| [`tools/list`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/list) |  |
| [`tools/logger`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/logger) |  |
| [`tools/mailer`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/mailer) |  |
| [`tools/osutils`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/osutils) |  |
| [`tools/picker`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/picker) |  |
| [`tools/router`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/router) |  |
| [`tools/routine`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/routine) |  |
| [`tools/search`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/search) |  |
| [`tools/security`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/security) |  |
| [`tools/store`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/store) |  |
| [`tools/subscriptions`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/subscriptions) |  |
| [`tools/template`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/template) | Package template is a thin wrapper around the standard html/template and text/template packages that implements a convenient registry to load and cache templates on the fly concurrently. |
| [`tools/tokenizer`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/tokenizer) | Package tokenizer implements a rudimentary tokens parser of buffered io.Reader while respecting quotes and parenthesis boundaries. |
| [`tools/types`](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/types) | Package types implements some commonly used db serializable types like datetime, json, etc. |
